body: Analyst predicts shocking sign behind Bitcoins price | Crypto Craft. * # Analyst predicts shocking sign behind Bitcoin’s price. Bitcoin (BTC) may have reclaimed $80,000, but one analyst warns that the move lacks the foundation to hold. On May 4, the top cryptocurrency finally managed to break past its $80,000 barrier. The first time it did was in the wee hours of Monday. However, it pulled back briefly and dropped to the zone of $78,000 as mixed reports of escalating crisis in the Strait of Hormuz spread.
